customer.business: WARS — a private invite-only anime/manga/light-novel reading + chat site for one friend group
customer.target: The founder's friends, roughly 18-30, anime/manga/light-novel fans already in a group chat together, who read on their phones and laptops and currently juggle Discord plus some reader site or shared files
customer.where: private website, invite only, no public access

behaviours.name: Lives in Discord
behaviours.how: The group chat is already their main app; anything new has to beat opening Discord.

behaviours.name: Phone-only reader
behaviours.how: Reads on a phone, often at night; if the mobile reader is bad, they are gone.

behaviours.name: Binge reader
behaviours.how: Reads dozens of chapters in one sitting when a series grabs them.

behaviours.name: Lurker
behaviours.how: Reads everything, says nothing; chat activity from them is rare.

behaviours.name: Official-sources only
behaviours.how: Uses VIZ, Manga Plus, J-Novel Club or buys volumes; uneasy about ripped files.

behaviours.name: Setup is fine, thanks
behaviours.how: Happy with their current folder-and-chat arrangement; slow to move tools.

objections: Discord + a shared folder already works fine
Another site, another login - I will forget it exists
Will the others actually use it, or does it die in two weeks
It only has Death Note and ORV - why not everything
Is this private really, or does a link leak it
Reading on the site has to be better than what I use now, on my phone
I do not want my reading or chat activity stored somewhere random
habits: you are in the group chat most days anyway
you read before bed on your phone
someone drops a chapter link and half the chat reacts
you switch apps between the reader and the chat without thinking
if a new tool is annoying once, you go back to the old one

pitch:
A private website for our group. Invite only — you get in with a username and a link only I send you.

You read Death Note (manga) and Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint (light novel) right in the browser. Vertical scroll or page-flip, and it remembers where you stopped.

Next to the reader there is a chat room, like a tiny Discord just for us — one room per series, reactions, replies.

Free. No ads. Nothing public: no one outside the group can see the site, the files, or the chat.

If you are in, I send you the link. If the site is annoying, tell me and I will fix it or kill it.
